ranks.note: Listed figure may be out of date. Commanders report the real threshold between 30,909,860,900 and 30,925,860,900 - about 30,917,860,900 give or take 8 million, as of July 3311.

extras.first_logged_bonus: A sample never turned in before pays 5x the base value in total: the base value plus a bonus of 4x the base. In a SellOrganicData journal event this is the Value field plus the Bonus field. Already-logged samples pay base only.
extras.sampling_tool: Genetic Sampler on the Artemis Suit; three samples of a species are needed for a complete set.
extras.estimating: Rank projections are predictions, not promises. Always quote a range: worst case assumes nothing is first logged (1x base), best case assumes everything is (5x). Lead with the worst case and round down when uncertain.
